# [BUG] ai-service never registers with Eureka — circular bootstrap via shared @LoadBalanced RestClient.Builder

## Bug

ai-service never appeared in Eureka's registry (`curl discovery-service:8761/eureka/apps` never listed AI-SERVICE), across multiple restarts. Direct calls to ai-service (port 8084) worked fine; gateway routing broke, since the gateway resolves `lb://ai-service` via Eureka and got "No instances available." Confirmed live via repeated log entries:
```
DiscoveryClient_AI-SERVICE/...:ai-service:8084 - registration failed Cannot execute request on any known server
Request execution error. endpoint=DefaultEndpoint{ serviceUrl='http://discovery-service:8761/eureka/}, exception=No instances available for discovery-service
```
Network connectivity from ai-service to discovery-service was fine (`wget http://discovery-service:8761/actuator/health` succeeded instantly) — not a network/DNS issue.

## Root Cause

A single shared `@LoadBalanced RestClient.Builder` bean served two purposes: `MovieCatalogClient`'s intentional use (resolving `lb://movie-service`), and an unqualified pickup by Spring Cloud Netflix Eureka's own internal registration/heartbeat client — routing Eureka's own bootstrap traffic through the load balancer, which itself needs Eureka's registry populated to resolve anything. Circular deadlock: ai-service could never register.

## Severity vs. Priority

**Severity (technical impact):** Critical — broke all gateway-routed traffic to ai-service; direct-to-service calls still worked
**Priority (business urgency):** P1-high — blocked #68 (voice control) from working end-to-end and blocked #48's live verification

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Fixed and verified live — `curl discovery-service:8761/eureka/apps` lists AI-SERVICE after startup
      (`gh run list --workflow=backend-ci.yml`; ai-service registers on startup)
- [x] Gateway routing confirmed working — `curl localhost:8080/api/v1/ai/speech-to-text` through the gateway succeeds (same path #68 relies on)
- [x] Regression test rescoped to a live check — the test suite disables Eureka (`eureka.client.enabled: false`) by design, so this class of bug isn't unit-testable; the live curl check above is the standing verification instead

## Notes

- Fix (`0db5cfc`): replaced the shared `RestClient.Builder` bean with a dedicated, pre-built `@LoadBalanced RestClient` bean scoped to `MovieCatalogClient` only, leaving the app-wide `RestClient.Builder` unqualified for Eureka's own client to use plainly.
- Blocked #68's voice control from working end-to-end through the browser prior to this fix.
